column1: # WP-B lane, 2026-09-27: the HTTP header captures (*.hdr) this lane committed while the global core.autocrlf=input
# was set. Git stored them with LF line ends; the captured bytes end every line in CRLF. Content is otherwise equal.
# Columns: path, sha256 of the stored (LF) blob, sha256 of the same bytes with CRLF line ends, the manifest that lists
# the file (or -), and how the CRLF form checks: crlf-matches = the manifest's hash is the CRLF form's;
# working-copy-crlf-matches = no manifest, and the lane's untouched working copy (CRLF) hashes to the CRLF form.
# The *.body captures are LF on the box and unaffected (the 108 with a manifest match it as stored).
# Restored: the commit that adds this file stores every listed capture with its CRLF bytes again (research/
# spill-b-20260919/.gitattributes marks *.hdr and *.body -text), so each stored blob hashes to the CRLF column and
# the listed manifests check. Before that commit the stored blobs are the LF column.
